scenarios.scenario: CHO Monoclonal Antibody (mAb) 2,000L Fed-Batch Bioreactor Inline Raman Glucose & Lactate MPC
scenarios.question: On Day 7 of a 14-day CHO cell culture ($1.8M batch value), exponential cell growth depletes glucose rapidly while excess bolus feeding triggers toxic Warburg lactate accumulation (>3.5 g/L)
scenarios.model_answer: Inline Raman spectroscopy probe measures glucose/lactate every 5 minutes; Monod-kinetic Hybrid MPC continuously modulates peristaltic nutrient feed to lock glucose at 2.2 ± 0.15 g/L (lactate < 1.4 g/L, +18% IgG titer, 0.8% yield loss)
scenarios.tier1_3_failure: Tier 1 once-daily offline BioProfile sampling + manual bolus feed overshoots glucose to 6.0 g/L, spiking lactate and osmolality and scrapping 11.4% of batches.

scenarios.scenario: 21 CFR Part 211 / EU Annex 11 Electronic Batch Record (eBR) Review-by-Exception (RbE) AST
scenarios.question: Release 145 completed commercial biologic and sterile fill-finish batches/month where each batch record contains 3,800 process parameters, LIMS COA results, and ALCOA+ audit-trail timestamps
scenarios.model_answer: Deterministic eBR AST verifies 100% of 3,794 within-CPP/CQA parameters automatically, isolating only the 6 out-of-trend (OOT) / manual-override entries for Qualified Person (QP) review (cuts release hold from 18.0 days to 0.6 days)
scenarios.tier1_3_failure: Tier 1 QA specialists spend 18 days manually reading 400 pages of normal parameters per batch, tying up $26M in finished cold-chain working capital.

scenarios.scenario: Eliminating 'Human Error / Retrain Operator' Placebo CAPAs via Equipment & Raw-Material Lot Genealogy
scenarios.question: Deviation #DEV-419 logs a sterile filtration pressure spike during Vial Fill Lot #882; draft ICH Q9/Q10 Root-Cause Analysis and CAPA
scenarios.model_answer: Traverse MES-LIMS-ERP genealogy graph across 90 days -> correlate pressure spike to Excipient Polysorbate-80 Supplier Lot #PS-991 peroxide degradation (not operator error); quarantine remaining drums of Lot #PS-991 (1.9% recurrence)
scenarios.tier1_3_failure: Tier 1 & Tier 2 Prompt LLM blame 'Operator failed to prime filter slowly' and prescribe 'Retrain operator on SOP-104', resulting in a 28.5%–31.0% repeat deviation rate on the next batch!

scenarios.scenario: Cold-Room Temperature Excursion Mean Kinetic Temperature (MKT) USP <1079> Stability Gate
scenarios.question: Cold Room #3 experiences a 42-minute defrost spike to +10.4°C (above +8.0°C alarm) while storing 4,000 vials of mAb drug substance
scenarios.model_answer: Compute exact Haynes USP <1079> Arrhenius Mean Kinetic Temperature (MKT = +4.6°C <= +5.0°C limit) + cumulative Time-Out-of-Refrigeration (TOR) budget across lot history -> confirm product stability intact with deterministic math (0.0% CQA escape)
scenarios.tier1_3_failure: Tier 2 Prompt LLM approximates logarithmic Arrhenius exponents in free text, risking release of thermally degraded biologics (5.4% escape).

key_findings: Tier 4 (Inline Raman PAT Bioreactor MPC + Deterministic 21 CFR Part 211 eBR Review-by-Exception AST + ICH Q9 Causal Genealogy CAPA Agent) cuts QA batch release hold time from 18.0 days to 0.6 days (-96.7%) with 0.0% ALCOA+ or CQA compliance escape.

Controlling 2,000L CHO fed-batch bioreactors via 5-minute inline Raman spectroscopy and Monod-kinetic Hybrid MPC prevents toxic Warburg lactate spikes and reduces titer/batch scrap loss from 11.4% to 0.8%.

Replacing placebo 'Human Error / Retrain Operator' CAPAs with cross-batch excipient/equipment genealogy graph root-cause analysis slashes repeat deviations from 28.5% to 1.9% and lowers monthly QA, hold, and scrap TCO from $980K to $82K (-91.6%).
